steps.text: Pickup at your hotel between 08:00 and 09:00, light breakfast at Lanta Old Town pier.
Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Pileh Lagoon, Monkey Beach and a snorkelling stop.
Lunch buffet on Phi Phi Don and time on the beach, then Bamboo Island: swimming, snorkelling from the beach or time to relax.
The boat leaves Bamboo Island for a snorkelling stop at Loh Mudee.
Free time on Phi Phi Don until 16:00, then back to Koh Lanta and the transfer to your hotel by car or by boat.

beforeYouBook.pickup: Pickup at your hotel between 08:00 and 09:00, by car or by boat. On the day trip, a light breakfast at Lanta Old Town pier. Sunset trip: pickup at 10:00 by car. Private speedboat: pickup at your hotel at the time you choose.
bring: Cash for the national park fee
beforeYouBook.weather: Maya Bay has its own rules set by the national park. The stop depends on the day and the season. The private longtail runs when the national park is open, and its programme can change with the tide and the weather.
beforeYouBook.cancellation: Day trip, sunset trip and private longtail: tell us at least 12 hours before departure, or the full price is charged. Private speedboat: we confirm the conditions with you when you book.

faq.q: How far is Phi Phi from Koh Lanta?
faq.a: About an hour by speedboat from the pier.

faq.q: Do we stop at Maya Bay?
faq.a: Yes, in the morning, with Viking Cave, Pileh Lagoon and Monkey Beach. Access to Maya Bay follows the national park rules of the day.

faq.q: Is the national park fee included?
faq.a: No. You pay 400 THB per adult and 200 THB per child in cash.

faq.q: Can we go on a private boat?
faq.a: Yes, a private longtail or a private speedboat, for your group only. On the longtail, children from 4 count in the group size. On the speedboat, you choose the departure time and you are back by 16:00 at the latest. Send us your date and group size on WhatsApp and we reply with the price for your day.

The day trip stops at Maya Bay and gives you free time on Phi Phi Don until 16:00. The sunset trip picks you up at 10:00, stops at Loh Samah, Monkey Beach, Phi Phi Don and Bamboo Island, and comes back at sunset with soft drinks and dinner. Maya Bay is not on this programme. The private longtail and the private speedboat are the whole boat for your group, and on the speedboat you choose the times.

legacyText.title: Koh Phi Phi Day Trip from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel
intro: Phi Phi is north of Koh Lanta. The speedboat crosses in about an hour. The morning is spent around Phi Phi Leh, the island with Maya Bay and Pileh Lagoon. After lunch on Phi Phi Don, the afternoon goes to Bamboo Island, with snorkeling from the beach.
legacyText.cardDescription: A day trip to the Phi Phi islands, with Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, Monkey Beach and snorkeling stops.
goodToKnow: Private speedboat option, 9:00 to 16:00, your group only.
Children from 4 to 11 pay a child rate.
Maya Bay has its own rules set by the national park. The stop depends on the day and the season.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. The national park fee is paid on the island and is not included. For a private speedboat, ask us.
legacyText.parkFee: 400 THB per adult and 200 THB per child (Thai nationals 40 and 20 THB)
legacyText.caption: Phi Phi

sources.from: Flyer du partenaire « Phi Phi Bamboo Island + Sunset » transmis par Jérémy le 22.11.2026 (départ de Koh Lanta, il remplace la brochure du 17.11.2026 qui partait d'un autre ponton) : adulte 2 900, enfant de 4 à 11 ans 1 900, programme 10.00 à 17.50, arrêts Phi Phi Don, Loh Samah, Monkey Beach et Bamboo Island, soft drinks et dîner au retour, transfert en voiture, « program and timing approximate […] tide and local weather conditions ». Compris limité à ce que dit le flyer (ni guide, ni assurance, ni matériel écrits). Aucun prix sous 4 ans, aucune taille de groupe, aucun jour de départ : rien d'écrit. Bateau « speedboat » comme la sortie Rok Haa + Sunset du même partenaire. Annulation : 12 h avant, comme le day trip. Frais de parc : ceux de la fiche.

notes: Saison : toute l'année sauf fermeture du parc national (réponse de Jérémy du 03.11.2026) ; pas de saison affichée tant que les mois de fermeture ne sont pas donnés.
